title: Overview shows ork's own engine runs
lead: The TUI Overview lists the engine runs the daemon already reports (ork status engine_runs) in Running and Needs you, and no longer labels an ork-started run as started elsewhere.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Seen 2026-10-20 while S21 ran through ork run: the Overview showed the ledger run as '> started elsewhere' and omitted the engine run. internal/tui/overview.go:95 builds Running only from the slicer ledger and labels every row kindExternal. docs/dashboard.md reserves that label for relays started outside ork (dash.external-runs). Needs-you already counts paused, stopped and awaiting-approval engine runs in ork status; the TUI shows none of them.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/tui/` (overview, model, keys as needed, goldens), `internal/daemon` and `internal/ipc` only if the TUI needs a new read, `docs/dashboard.md`.
- Not in this slice: TUI actions (approve, stop, answer, launch). Open design questions for the owner: how a ledger run and its engine run join into one row, and which keys the later action slice uses.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- An engine run appears in Running with its state and what it waits on; awaiting-approval, paused and stopped runs appear in Needs you.
- The ledger run that belongs to an engine run is shown once, not as started elsewhere; a ledger run with no engine run still shows as started elsewhere.
- Counts and the sidebar badge match ork status.
- New goldens at 80x24 and 100x30 for a run in each state.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Read engine runs in the TUI refresh and render them; join ledger and engine runs by item and worktree (the join rule is a design question, to be decided before building).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go test -race ./...`, `go vet ./...`, `gofmt -l .` clean; SPDX headers; no new dependency.
- `slicer check` and `adj lint` pass.
- [HUMAN CHECK] Run a slice with ork run and see it in the Overview.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit: "S22: Overview shows ork engine runs".
